mapper.select: SELECT holding_id, client_id, instrument_id, quantity, price_per_unit, overall_gains, created_at, updated_at FROM portfolio_holding WHERE client_id = #{clientId} AND instrument_id = #{instrumentId}

SELECT holding_id, client_id, instrument_id, quantity, price_per_unit, overall_gains, created_at, updated_at FROM portfolio_holding WHERE client_id = #{clientId} AND instrument_id = #{instrumentId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO portfolio_holding (client_id, instrument_id, quantity, price_per_unit, overall_gains, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{clientId}, #{instrumentId}, #{quantity}, #{pricePerUnit}, 0, now(), now())
mapper.update: UPDATE portfolio_holding SET quantity = quantity + #{quantity}, price_per_unit = ((price_per_unit * quantity) + (#{pricePerUnit} * #{quantity})) / (quantity + #{quantity}), overall_gains = overall_gains, updated_at = now() WHERE client_id = #{clientId} AND instrument_id = #{instrumentId}
UPDATE portfolio_holding SET quantity = quantity - #{quantity}, updated_at = now() WHERE client_id = #{clientId} AND instrument_id = #{instrumentId}
